Results.ReviewText: No other grilling device can compare to a Weber! Flat out the BEST!
Results.Title: Best Grill Ever!

Results.ReviewText: Bought this for its versatility.  Grilling, smoking, pizza oven. I'm glad I did. Haven't been disappointed!
Results.Title: Well built,  love the grill

Results.ReviewText: Just used my weber for the first time on yesterday love it cooks great
Results.Title: First cook on my weber

Results.ReviewText: My first charcoal BBQ and it works like a charm. Holds very well temperature and I even had the chance to do low and slow cooking. Great results each time.
Results.Title: Great versatility

ClientResponses.Response:
Thank you for your feedback. We are glad you are enjoying your 22" Kettle. Sorry to hear about your experience with the removable grate. 

Our kind Support team would like to follow up with you. Please be on the lookout for an email, thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: I always enjoy cooking on the weber kettle grills. The grate on this one is actually very bothersome. When I first used it I was using the wire brush to clean the grates and the centerpiece dislodged and fell into the charcoals. Good thing I wasn't starting my cook. Because of this I have not cooked on it a second time.
Results.Title: Great grill except for the grate.

Results.ReviewText: I have been looking for charcoal grills and smokers for over 2 years and finally decided on the Weber kettle. It’s so versatile and food tastes amazing.  And can’t go wrong with a Weber with a 10 year warranty. I also have a gas grill and it’s a workhorse. Love my Weber grills!!
Results.Title: How BBQ should be done.

Results.ReviewText: Just a well made, simple, easy to use grill. Master Touch has a few nice upgrades over standard kettle, the best of which is the lid holder. Toasting rack and removable center cooking grate are fine, but not must haves imo. Included briquette tins are nice for when you want to cook indirect, keeps things tidier. Color options are good, we love ours in blue. Would be nice if a cover was included, but we bought one separately to keep it in the best condition possible.
Results.Title: Classic for a reason

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for your feedback. Our kind Support team would like to follow up with you. Please be on the lookout for an email, thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: Poor quality, not easily assembled. Legs didn’t work. Holes weren’t drilled that we’re supposed to be pre drilled. Overall, I expected better quality.
Results.Title: Poor quality

Results.ReviewText: J'ai acheté le mois dernier. Offre un contrôle simple de la température pour des cuisson parfaite et la grille gourmet permet un éventail de possibilités. J'adore!!
Results.Title: Simplement parfait!!

Results.ReviewText: It is bigger, taller, sturdier than expected. I am very pleased.
Results.Title: Master Touch Griller

Results.ReviewText: This is my third Weber. I currently have an 18” Smokey Mountain, an 18” inch Classic Kettle adn now this 22” Master Touch Kettle. Weber has the best products and a superb service!
Results.Title: Great product!!!

Results.ReviewText: This weber kettle is one of the most versatile and efficient charcoal grills I have owned.
Results.Title: Awesome grill!

Results.ReviewText: I had a Weber Kettle 30 years ago. I recently decided to jump back into charcoal barbecuing and bought a Weber Master Touch. And in Weber tradition, it is a great grill. The Master Touch has a sliding lid, I only wish the lid slid completely open. That is my only criticism.
Results.Title: Weber Master Touch for the little extra

ClientResponses.Response: We are sorry to hear about your experience and  would like to hear more. Please lookout for an email from our Support team. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: The handle on the vent adjuster melted otherwise it’s a good grill for the price
Results.Title: Good grill 1 flaw

Results.ReviewText: good grill i am liking it a lot and it cooks good and looks nice
Results.Title: i have had a good time with it

Results.ReviewText: Easy to use for perfect grilling every time.  Indirect grilling is the way to go!
Results.Title: Ease of use

ClientResponses.Response: We apologize for your frustration, that is not the experience we want our loyal Weber fans to have. Please lookout for an email from our Support team.
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: We've had no luck grilling so far...we get the chimney started, pour in the coals, close the lid, wait...following all the directions and still don't have enough heat to completely cook what we have. Very frustrating. The chimney took 26 minutes to get ashy at the top, no help to be found in figuring out why. Still trying, but it's not the fun we hoped for. Endless need for accessories is annoying. But beautiful item, and easy to buildsothere's that.
Results.Title: Meh.

ClientResponses.Response:
Thank you for your feedback. Here at Weber, we stand by the quality of our products. 

Please be on the lookout for an email from our support team to follow up with you.
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: I bought master touch to replace my original Weber 22 inch kettle because the bottom rotted out ,I don't think all the features that you get for the master touch are worth the extra $150 .
Results.Title: Nothing special

ClientResponses.Response:
We are happy to hear you are enjoying your new Master-Touch grill. Sounds like we would need to request photos of the damage. Here at Weber, we stand by the quality of our products and cover them under great warranties. 

Our team is looking into what caused this matter so we can provide further assistance, we would like to follow up with you. Please be on the lookout for an email, thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: Good grill but came all dented and paint chipped. No damage to the outside container so wasn’t damaged during shipping. A big let down for the price and too much trouble to send back
Results.Title: Quality isn’t exactly at the price point

Results.ReviewText: Parents had a kettle when growing up and like many drifted away to gas grills. Was not getting the flavor and versatility that I remember and picked up my new kettle and the quality is still as I remember.  Had one small problem due to shipping and Weber was right on top of it and had that part shipped out within a couple days and even delivered on a Sunday!
Results.Title: Back to the basics and great cooking

Results.ReviewText: Great BBQ Holds the temperature well and is easy to use
Results.Title: Master-Touch Charcoal Grill 22"

ClientResponses.Response: We are looking into what caused this matter so we can provide further assistance, our kind Support team would like to follow up with you. Please be on the lookout for an email, thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: Bottom grate rusted in just 6 months. Supposed to be covered by warranty Weber said they would send a replacement but never did.
Results.Title: Poor quality & no customer service

ClientResponses.Response:
Thank you for your feedback. We are happy to hear you are enjoying the 22" Master-Touch grill. 

Please take a look at the hinged cooking grate option. The link will be provided below,

https://www.weber.com/US/en/accessories/accessories-by-grill-type/charcoal-replacement-parts/cooking-grate/8835.html

We would like to hear more about this experience. Please lookout for an email from our Support team.
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: The grill itself is awesome but the grate center being removable is terrible. It falls out if you hang it from the side of the grill. Ive had it flip into the coals while brushing it. I've dropped it into the hot coals trying to just put it in. There should be some kind of latching system where if you want to remove it you have to do something not that it just falls out constantly.
Results.Title: Great grill. Gourmet system not so much.

Results.ReviewText: Great evolutions in this iteration of the classic Weber kettle grill, love it
Results.Title: Great Product

Results.ReviewText: I have owned several Weber Grills, Gas and Charcoal. I also own a pellet grill from another mfg. However, I still like charcoal. And for the simplicity, and features of this latest purchase. I'm again very pleased.
Results.Title: Master Touch

Results.ReviewText: Bought this couple weeks ago to use it as a smoker and it work just fine
Results.Title: Great product!

Results.ReviewText: Got it for a early father's day gift. Love it all things work great. Easy to put together,  if anyone has problems putting it together. They don't need 1 . Have used it a lot and it works great.
Results.Title: All things work great

Results.ReviewText: Il y a 1 mois que je possède ce charmant Bbq et je l'adore
Results.Title: Vraiment très fonctionnel

Results.ReviewText: I like the quality of the 22" master touch and versatility that it provides for a kettle style grill for both grilling and smoking different items, which also makes it creative for doing other types of food items.
Results.Title: Grilling magic of the master touch

Results.ReviewText: Overall great product but my grill grate has already started to rust after about one month. I did not expect this to happen so soon.
Results.Title: Weber Master Touch Grill

Results.ReviewText: Long time Weber user from gas to charcoal to smokers and it seems they just seem to get better. This addition to my collection is becoming my most used grill. I like the fact that you have many options to griddle, grill , smoke or use a Wok. Using different charcoal setups with the vent system and Temp gage allows many options for cooking temperatures and the addition of a chunk or two of various woods adds more flavor. A nice feature is the lid holder that's convenient while trending to food. I greatly enjoy a product that offers a good Warranty too. To me it means quality with many years of trouble free service which has been the case with all the Weber products I own. Great grill......may purchase another in different color !
Results.Title: Hooked on Webers

Results.ReviewText: Love the Weber 22" Master Touch BBQ. However the support system needs to be updated. Very flimsy legs and or anchor points. Need to fix this issue.
Results.Title: Flimsy legs on Weber 22" Master Touch

Results.ReviewText: The best kettle grill.  So easy to use and my favorite thing to grill on. A Classic
Results.Title: Perfect grill

Results.ReviewText:
Great value for the money and everything is better on charcoal.
Love it.
Results.Title: Better tasting BBQ

Results.ReviewText: Great grill! Had a smaller kettle we enjoyed for years and this one is a great upgrade. One self inflicted problem. I was cooking a pizza and the temp inside the kettle was so hot it melted the plastic hand guard on the domes vent control. Totally my fault. We love the grill!
Results.Title: Master-Touch Charcoal Grill 22"

Results.ReviewText: Love most things about this almost classic. Two nitpicks: The center insert is a pain to deal with separately as you’re moving things around with every operation. It would be grate (get it?) if it was secured somehow except for the fewer times most people would use the insert. Also, the damper seems to take a ton of back and forth to empty the ashes bit by bit. Seems like on the older ones a few swipes and you were done. Other than than, it’s awesome, and you know that already.
Results.Title: Two Minor Gripes

Results.ReviewText: Weber Support was quick to ship me replacement bolts that were faulty with my newly purchased Master Touch. Other than that the Master Touch is working great and I love the enhanced features it offers compared to the other Weber Kettles.
Results.Title: Quick Replacement of faulty part

Results.ReviewText: Weber did a great job modifying this classic grill. The new ash catcher works great and makes cleaning the grill easy. The grates new design make it possible to access the charcole level during grilling, to add more charcole or smoke chips. I also purchased the Griddle, for the removable center grate, a great addition for cooking breakfast on the BBQ. There are more moving parts to the Master-Touch but built with qualtity.
Results.Title: Great New Features

Results.ReviewText: Déjà  1 mois  et très  satisfait  ! Le meilleur  achat que j'ai fait.
Results.Title: Super polyvalent

Results.ReviewText: Absolutely love the Weber 22 inch master touch the best charcoal grill I’ve ever grilled on
Results.Title: 22 inch master touch

Results.ReviewText: BBQ'd my first tri-tip in this grill following the snake charcoal and wood chip technique.  The smoky taste and tenderness of the meat blew us away.  This is now my favorite grill, having had many different types over my 50+ years of grilling.  Wish I had gotten this grill years ago.  Well made and of very good quality.
Results.Title: Best Grill of a Lifetime

Results.ReviewText: J'ai acheté ce produit il y a quelque mois un pour chez moi et un pour le camping j'aime beaucoup mon weber la nourriture est super cuit sur le charbon je me sert plus de mon bbq au propane depuis ...
Results.Title: Super achat

Results.ReviewText: Facilité de maintenir la température stable je l'adore
Results.Title: Très bon BBQ

Results.ReviewText: Try not to lose any screws during assembly. Lost the one for the side handle
Results.Title: Good grill

Results.ReviewText: While I realize I can put any cast iron pan on the grates, the removable center grate with the skillet insert (purchased separately) is super convenient. I grilled peppers & onions in the skillet while Italian sausages (meat on one side, veggie on the other) surrounded the skillet. My family loved it when I brought in the platter of sausages and the skillet with the peppers & onions still sizzling! Splurged on the Master-Touch as an early Father's Day gift, and it is worth every penny.
Results.Title: A splurge, but well worth it!

Results.ReviewText: I got this as a gift for my brother and he LOVED IT. Only knocking a star since the leg brace was slightly damaged. The coating was chipped and could see bare metal.
Results.Title: Almost Perfect...buy still Amazing!

14501001.Name: 22” Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill
14501001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill. This grill features a handy Tuck-Away Lid Holder that gives you a convenient place to nest the lid against the side of the bowl, a hinged cooking grate that fits circular GBS accessories so you can explore more ways to cook, a built-in lid thermometer, and legs that are 2” taller than standard kettles. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retain heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate fits circular GBS grillware· Included Char-Rails make it easy to arrange charcoal· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Tuck-Away Lid Holder provides handy space to hang lid· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels.· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant and 2” taller· 10-year limited warranty
